deals.title: Skrine leads Denmark's tax authority in civil suits to recover approximately RM1 billion
deals.summary: Skrine acted as lead counsel for the Customs and Tax Administration of the Kingdom of Denmark, plaintiff in civil suits against multiple Malaysian entities and related individuals, and successfully resisted an application to set aside service of the writ out of jurisdiction.
deals.label: sought in civil recovery suits in Malaysia

deals.title: TotalEnergies acquires a 30% operated interest in the Lang Lebah and B14 gas fields offshore Sarawak
deals.summary: Skrine acted as Malaysian legal counsel to TotalEnergies on its arrangements with PETRONAS Carigali, PTTEP and KUFPEC. Lang Lebah is one of Malaysia's largest offshore gas discoveries.
deals.label: more than 6.5 trillion cubic feet of gas resources across the Lang Lebah and B14 fields

deals.title: AME Elite and UEM Sunrise form a joint venture for an industrial development in the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone
deals.summary: Skrine acted as legal counsel to AME Development on the 50:50 joint venture to develop 402.1 acres of freehold industrial land in Gerbang Nusajaya, Iskandar Puteri.
deals.label: estimated gross development value

deals.title: AirTrunk secures the largest green project financing for a single data centre in Malaysia
deals.summary: Skrine acted as Malaysian counsel for AirTrunk on the financing for its JHB2 hyperscale data centre campus in Johor Bahru — AirTrunk's largest single-asset financing to date.
deals.label: green financing from 30 financial institutions
deals.team: Lee Ai Hsian · Javene Fan · Chong Zhi Shin
